title: The Longest Night and the Return of Light
short_teaser: The winter solstice marks the shortest day and longest night of the year in the Northern Hemisphere.
story: The winter solstice marks the shortest day and longest night of the year in the Northern Hemisphere. After it, daylight begins returning gradually. A turning point may occur before the improvement is easy to feel. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
